people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
translations.bsb: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
translations.kjv: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
translations.asv: Wherefore he saith, Awake, thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall shine upon thee.
